Name: BATH
Description: Pet bath for shorter stays on request

Name: Daily Groomin
Description: Brushing of hair,cleaning of eyes and ears,Brushing of teeth(pet Parent to provide toothbrush and paste),Checking of Paws,Daily checks for ticks and Fleas

Name: EXIT BATH
Description: Bath given after 10 days of stay or more in normal stays and after 15 days in monsoons(June to September)

Name: MEDICATION
Description: Daily medication ,if required,as per vet or pet  parent instructions

Name: SPECIAL CARE
Description: Any special care required for paraplegic dogs/Blind dogs/Wound Dressings/Care for Pregnant dogs/Care for newborn puppies or any other special care will be chargeable on case to case basis
